bio: Not far from Nørreport station, Høst is a busy neighbourhood restaurant that offers an enjoyable atmosphere and good value cooking. Dishes are modern, boldly flavoured and visually impressive, and the set menus come with lots of extra surprises. Nordic fish and shellfish feature largely, while the vegetarian dishes – like celeriac with truffle and ´Vesterhavsost’ – are some of the highlights of the menu....
